name: The Invisible Dragon
original_name: เคียงมังกร
overview:
Khun is a passionate young man eager to become the Lion's Head for the Dragon Festival. But he's also interested in Earn.

Earn, on the other hand, is more concerned with summoning the dragon. Being an adopted child, he doesn't have dragon blood flowing in his veins.

As they train, Earn and Khun grow closer, but an obstacle stands in their way: Leng.
